prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and identity-preserve.
Create a final reusable later-stage full-body named character source C01-CHAR-TORREN-02 as a native 1024x1536 RGBA transparent PNG. Reference1 is the APPROVED named stage01 portrait and PRIMARY authority for FACE, skin/ethnicity, BIG HEAD/HANDS, broad readable proportions, strong dark contours and chunky MATTE rendering. Reference2 is an old later-stage card: use only its named stage POSE and specified EQUIPMENT, NOT its background/frame, gritty fine texture or any conflicting face/age.
Match reference1's bold small-game-portrait art EXACTLY: much BIGGER head and hands, stocky broad torso, short sturdy limbs, about FOUR head-lengths total from helmet/head top to boot soles. Maintain adult anatomy despite cartoon proportions. Heavy dark outer outline, broad flat midtone color masses with a few matte painted facets. Faces and equipment bright/readable, not dark/blackened. Simplify all tiny texture, hair strands, thin etched rivets, scratch noise, filigree. Wear must be few broad patches/scuffs, no gritty granular surface. Full silhouette and complete feet/props comfortably INSIDE all edges.
Subject and role: Torren, later Old Flag squad officer, recognizably the SAME named man as reference1 now a mature young adult. Same brown hair, heavy concerned eyebrows, tired large eyes, long angular nose, warm skin and plain Lorne rounded brimmed metal helmet. He has a subtly healed cheek scar and faint stubble, never elderly. Tired, wary, solemn, loyal by his own choice. Reconstruct his later worn muted Lorne-blue officer coat from reference2 over mail, repaired patches, leather cross-strap and large practical belt, dark scarf, sturdy brown boots. In his right hand at viewer-left he holds a thick rolled order/map upright; his left arm at viewer-right carries the same patched round wood-and-iron shield. Narrative-priority additional prop missing in old reference2: a SINGLE old LEFT leather glove belonging to Roderick, carefully folded at its cuff and tucked securely into an open small chest satchel at his upper belt. The worn tan-brown glove has clearly visible grouped fingers and separate thumb, its knuckles show one broad repaired seam. It is an empty glove kept safe, not a severed hand and not worn by Torren. Make glove shape large/readable but secondary to face. No flagpole or crown. No Gray Flag uniform. No spear in this later portrait; existing sword combat is separate.
Composition: single full-body figure, slightly three-quarter, centered at generous near-full canvas scale with large head near the upper margin and wide readable hands. Leave at least35px genuinely transparent margin around ALL body and props; no cropping. Complete soles near bottom with margin, no floor. Native output MUST be 1024x1536.
Transparency constraints: isolated character and carried equipment only on genuine transparent alpha. NO parchment/card/frame, NO text, no checkerboard, no environment, no cast/contact/drop shadow, no glow or halo. Every canvas edge actually transparent. Do not include black/white background, do not imitate transparency. Preserve full canvas.
